snippet.title: BUSTAFIELD 2: HoodLine - Latest Version DOWNLOAD
snippet.description:
The new version includes some new weapons and maps.
The weapon randomiser feature for bots is scrapped because it's causing some kit bugs. But the weapon unlocks are still present.

Ensure the Anti-Aliasing setting is set to OFF before playing!

NO EXTERNAL/COPY/MIRROR LINKS ALLOWED!
Download the latest version here (standalone release):
https://drive.google.com/file/d/1WmowXBYw-hoiuupjvplvCcC55u0vBdBy/view?usp=sharing

To disable (toggle) Reshade: Shift + F1.
To open the Reshade menu/settings: Shift + F2.
To remove Reshade: Delete d3d9.dll from the game's main directory.
